description: An oil painting of a baby asleep in a dark carved wooden rocking cradle beside a sunlit window. On the left a globe sits on a stack of old books on a table, and the top spine reads "NATURAL" in painted letters. Outside, a grey industrial skyline of smoking chimneys and low houses with lit windows. A signature sits in the lower right, and the painting is inset within a wide white margin on all sides.
reason: Shows a sleeping baby in a cradle over a smoking industrial city, not a novel being published or Austen's world of manners and marriage; it reads as a birth in the Industrial Revolution. The book spines carry legible painted lettering ("NATURAL...") and there is a painted signature in the lower right. The painting sits inside a white border instead of filling the image edge to edge.
